summary: Iteration 13 – Legal & Compliance features. BACKEND (12/12 pytest passing, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_legal_compliance.py against live preview API): POST /api/auth/signup returns 422 when age_confirmed or agreed_to_terms is missing/false (tested all 3 combinations); valid consent returns 201 with access_token + user containing has_seen_trading_disclaimer=false/has_seen_mingle_safety=false. GET /api/auth/me returns both new boolean flags. PUT /api/me persists has_seen_trading_disclaimer and has_seen_mingle_safety independently, verified via follow-up GET. DELETE /api/auth/me soft-deletes (sets deleted_at); subsequent login with same creds returns 401 'Invalid email or password', and the old JWT itself becomes invalid (401) since resolve_token filters deleted_at=None. Demo account regression confirmed: login, /auth/me, /posts feed, /membership all still 200. FRONTEND (Expo web 390x844): (1) Signup consent flow — filling the form and tapping 'Create account' opens signup-consent-sheet with correct subtitle, both checkboxes, tappable Terms/Privacy links; confirm button is a true no-op while unchecked (tapping it while both boxes are unchecked keeps the sheet open, no API call); checking both boxes enables it and tapping confirm creates the account (verified via a live throwaway signup) and proceeds into onboarding. (2) Legal pages — navigated directly to all 9 /legal/<slug> routes (terms, privacy, community-guidelines, trading-disclaimer, mingle-safety, premium-policy, affiliate-disclosure, dmca, account-deletion); every one renders legal-doc-screen with a title, back button, and non-blank placeholder body. (3) Profile settings sheet — profile-menu-button opens sheet with Account (email + Log out), LEGAL section with exactly 9 profile-legal-<slug> rows, DANGER ZONE with deletion-policy link and Delete Account button; tapping Delete Account shows profile-delete-confirm inline view; Cancel correctly returns to the menu WITHOUT deleting the demo account (verified demo login/profile still intact afterward). Delete+relogin-fails flow was separately verified end-to-end on throwaway accounts via API and matches the required 401 behavior. (4) Trading Only — verified on a fresh throwaway premium account: trading-disclaimer-modal appears on first /trading visit, 'I Understand' dismisses it, and it correctly does NOT reappear on a second visit; feed/header/compose/search buttons work normally. On demo (who had already acknowledged it previously) the modal correctly stayed hidden. (5) Single & Mingle — demo account had has_seen_mingle_safety=false; mingle-safety-modal appeared on first visit with 'Got It', legal link opened mingle-safety legal page, confirming persisted the flag (verified via reload — modal did not reappear); Discover screen and Pass/Say Hi/Interested buttons work without regression. (6) Premium tab / paywalls — premium-policy-link only renders in the non-premium plan-picker branch (by design, since it sits 'near the Activate button'); verified visible+working on a fresh non-premium account's Premium tab, and paywall-policy-link verified working on the Trading Only paywall for a non-premium user, both opening /legal/premium-policy correctly. (7) Regression — Home feed, Premium hub cards/navigation, Accountability Partners screen (plan/session/progress all rendered with existing data) all confirmed working with no changes from this batch.

minor.issue: Soft-deleted accounts keep their email_normalized occupied (unique index), so a user who deletes their account can NEVER sign up again with the same email — subsequent signup attempts return 409 'An account with this email already exists' forever. This may be intentional for audit/compliance reasons, but if users expect to be able to re-register after deletion, this is a UX gap worth confirming with the user/product owner.

ui_bugs.issue: When a legal link inside a modal (signup-consent-sheet, trading-disclaimer-modal-legal-link, mingle-safety-modal-legal-link) is tapped, the app navigates to /legal/<slug> but the originating RN Modal stays visually mounted on top of the legal page (screenshots show the legal content behind the still-open modal card). Functionally harmless — back navigation and the confirm button both still work correctly afterward — but it's a visual overlay glitch that could confuse users who expect the modal to close on navigation.

action_items: Consider (product decision, not a bug): whether soft-deleted accounts should free up their email for re-signup, or whether permanent email-lock is intended for compliance/audit trail purposes.

Cosmetic only: consider dismissing/hiding the parent FirstEntryModal (or signup consent Modal) when its 'Read the full policy' link is tapped, so the legal page doesn't render with a modal card floating on top of it; re-show the modal on back-navigation. Not blocking since the flow works and legal content is fully readable and links function correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth.py: SignupBody defaults age_confirmed/agreed_to_terms to False and the handler explicitly 422s if either is falsy — correct enforcement, and Pydantic's default bool coercion (accepts 'yes'/1/True-ish values) is standard and not a bug.

routes_auth.py delete_account: soft-delete + clearing user_sessions is correct; resolve_token filters deleted_at=None on every request so JWTs invalidate immediately without needing a blocklist — clean design.
core.py public_user(): has_seen_trading_disclaimer/has_seen_mingle_safety are coerced with bool() defensively even if unset in older docs — good backward compatibility for pre-existing users.

use-first-entry-flag.ts: onError also sets visible=false so a failed PUT doesn't trap the user behind the modal forever — good defensive UX; means the flag might not actually persist if that PUT truly failed (edge case only surfaces on network failure, acceptable tradeoff).

legal-content.ts: all 9 docs are clearly marked as PLACEHOLDER text with an explicit comment noting official copy must replace them before reliance — correctly flagged for follow-up, not a bug in this codebase.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all scoped legal/compliance flows + full regression pass

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created and fully cleaned up (soft-deleted) 5 throwaway accounts during testing: test_legal_ui_*, test_legal_ui2_*, test_trading_disc_*, test_paywall_*, test_bool_edge*, test_resignup_after_delete. Demo account (demo@leveluphub.com) was never deleted — only its Cancel path was exercised in the delete-confirm UI, and its has_seen_mingle_safety flag was legitimately flipped True via the real mingle-safety-modal confirm flow (matches expected one-time-modal behavior, not a test artifact needing cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All legal/compliance features from this batch (signup consent gate, 9 legal pages, profile settings LEGAL + DANGER ZONE sections, trading disclaimer one-time modal, mingle safety one-time modal, premium/paywall policy links, backend consent enforcement + soft-delete) are verified working end-to-end on live preview. No regressions found in Home feed, Premium hub, Accountability, or Mingle discover swipe actions. Only two non-blocking items surfaced: (1) soft-deleted accounts permanently lock their email from re-signup (business-logic question, not a bug), and (2) a cosmetic modal-stays-mounted-during-navigation visual glitch when tapping legal links from inside first-entry modals. Demo account's has_seen_mingle_safety flag is now True (legitimately flipped during this test run) — has_seen_trading_disclaimer was already True before this run started.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no blocking bugs found in this iteration.
